message.content: {"hts_code": "6404.11.2090", "reason": "Footwear with rubber/plastic outer soles and uppers that is not athletic (no cushioning) but has a foxing-like band overlapping the upper by more than ¼ inch falls under HTSUS 6404.11 (sports footwear/athletic-type with textile uppers) or 6402 for rubber/plastic uppers; since the uppers are rubber/plastics and the foxing-like band classifies it under 6402.99 (other footwear with outer soles and uppers of rubber or plastics), the applicable code is 6402.99.3170 (men's, valued over $3/pair, not otherwise specified)."}
